high: house / techno / tech-house / acid / electro / minimal / melodic — DJ sets of all sizes
mainstream & festival-scale house / tech-house headliners (Chris Lake, FISHER, John Summit, Dom Dolla, Gorgon City, etc.) — big-room fun counts, not just the underground
fabric-London-style proper club nights / European-leaning dance lineups
rooftop / sunset / daytime open-air house, disco, Balearic, groove sets
rep & arthouse cinema (Vidiots, Vista, Brain Dead, Cinematheque, New Bev)
medium: live electronic / electronic-adjacent acts (Rüfüs Du Sol, ODESZA, Bonobo, Jamie xx tier)
small rock / indie band shows at clubs (Troubadour, Echo, Zebulon, Moroccan, Lodge Room, Teragram) — post-punk, indie, garage, dream-pop, experimental, krautrock-y

daytime & lifestyle — flea / vintage / design markets (Rose Bowl Flea, Melrose Trading Post), farmers markets (esp. Silver Lake/eastside), food & drink pop-ups, brand activations / block parties / spritz-type parties, neighborhood street fairs
record fairs, listening bars, food events with a music angle
craft beer events / brewery takeovers / festivals
low: standup comedy — NOT generally wanted; only known/favorite names (see comedians_loved)
stadium pop, museum/gallery openings (skip ongoing exhibitions unless closing soon)

boosts: vinyl-only or "all night long" / open-to-close single-DJ sets
European vibe/feel — UK/EU DJs, labels (fabric, Rush Hour, Running Back, Defected, Hot Creations, Innervisions, Keinemusik) / Balearic-disco
groove / soulful / deep / dub / disco-leaning house
lineup artist in artists_tracked (also gets a "tracked" badge; effectively +2 via the list)
walkable or short drive from Silver Lake (Hyperion & Del Mar)
independent editorial mention (LAist, Time Out, DiscoverLA, 6AM, Dirty Epic) — +1 per source
early-bird ticket tier still available / on-sale or selling fast
penalties: generic Top-40 / open-format / hip-hop "club night" with no real DJ billing
hardstyle / gabber / happy-hardcore / hard-dance as the main draw (not the lane)
18+ EDM mega-raves built on production over selection
tribute / cover bands, "[decade] night" nostalgia club nights
sports-bar watch parties, trivia, open-mics, networking mixers, webinars (World Cup etc. belongs in "Around town," not the picks)
far-flung (Temecula / Anaheim / OC / SD / Ventura / SF) unless genuinely worth the trip
